source_text: Iustificati ergo ex fide pacem habemus ad Deum per Dominum nostrum Iesum Christum. Gloriamur in spe gloriae Dei; tribulatio patientiam operatur.
pass_a_gloss: Justified therefore from faith we have peace toward God through our Lord Jesus Christ. We glory in the hope of the glory of God; tribulation works patience.
pass_b_english: [[Since we have been justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ >> Bible:Romans 5:1]]. We [[rejoice in hope of the glory of God >> Bible:Romans 5:2]]; [[suffering produces endurance >> Bible:Romans 5:3]].
notes: True OET; no Scheck FOTC Romans.
anf_compare: no ANF for Rufinus Romans; do not copy Scheck FOTC
